item.text: {"text":"{\"code\":\"\\\"use strict\\\";\\n\\nfunction initialize(db) {\\n  db.exec(`\\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS effects (\\n      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,\\n      event_id TEXT NOT NULL,\\n      payload TEXT NOT NULL,\\n      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, event_id)\\n    );\\n  `);\\n}\\n\\nfunction ingest(db, { tenantId, eventId, payload }) {\\n  if (db.isTransaction) {\\n    throw new Error(\\\"ingest must run outside a transaction\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  const result = db.prepare(`\\n    INSERT INTO effects (tenant_id, event_id, payload)\\n    VALUES (?, ?, ?)\\n    ON CONFLICT(tenant_id, event_id) DO NOTHING\\n  `).run(tenantId, eventId, payload);\\n\\n  if (result.changes === 1 || result.changes === 1n) {\\n    return \\\"accepted\\\";\\n  }\\n\\n  const existing = db.prepare(`\\n    SELECT payload FROM effects WHERE tenant_id = ? AND event_id = ?\\n  `).get(tenantId, eventId);\\n\\n  if (!existing) {\\n    throw new Error(\\\"Existing effect not found after insert conflict\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return existing.payload === payload ? \\\"duplicate\\\" : \\\"conflict\\\";\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = { initialize, ingest };\\n\"}"}
